name: SG-Bench
description: Ensuring the safety of large language model (LLM) applications is essential for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Current LLM safety benchmarks have two limitations. First, they focus solely on either discriminative or generative evaluation paradigms while ignoring their interconnection.
reputation: A recent safety benchmark proposing both discriminative and generative evaluation, with limited but growing interest in LLM safety assessment.
notes: Safety benchmarks can be sensitive to prompt format and policy wording; likely combines several sub-metrics across discriminative and generative tasks.
